title: In situ characterization techniques for electrochemical nitrate-to-ammonia conversion
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4507-4525
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00564G, Review Article
Weijun Tian, Heng Guo, Tingsong Li, Shumin Luo, Shiqi Tian, Ying Zhou
Electrocatalytic nitrate reduction and advanced in situ characterization techniques can be synergistically integrated, enabling the sustainable conversion of “waste-to-resource” through precise mechanistic insights and real-time monitoring.
